title: Balancing act: when to flex and when to stay fixed
source_summary: This article offers key insights into selecting automation platforms for chemical processes, emphasizing fixed automation for standardized tasks and flexible automation for dynamic research, to help researchers make informed, tailored decisions.
abstract: Building automated platforms in chemical processes is a shared goal by many researchers. Herein, we provide essential insights into the decision-making process for choosing automation platforms, highlighting the suitability of fixed automation for standardized tasks and the strategic use of flexible automation in dynamic research settings. By addressing key factors, we aim to assist researchers in making informed decisions tailored to their specific automation needs.
